plugins.name: faulty-toolhead-1
plugins.title: Faulty Toolhead 1 Bypass
plugins.description: Temporary recovery override for Snapmaker U1 error 0003-0523-0000-0002 when toolhead 1's thermistor is damaged and blocks boot. Remaps [extruder] sensor_pin to e0:PC5, raises max_temp and drops max_power so the dead sensor is ignored, and neutralizes the e0_nozzle_fan nozzle fan. Do not heat or print with toolhead 1 while this is enabled; disable it once the part is replaced. Per-toolhead and independent, so several can be enabled at once.
plugins.tagline: Boot the U1 with a damaged toolhead 1 thermistor.
plugins.author: bespoked
